Trace, implement and test: 剑指 Offer II 063. 替换单词

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class Solution {
public:
    string replaceWords(vector<string>& dictionary, string sentence) {
        unordered_set<string> s(dictionary.begin(), dictionary.end());
        istringstream is(sentence);
        vector<string> words;
        string ss;
        while (is >> ss) words.push_back(ss);
        for (int i = 0; i < words.size(); ++i) {
            string word = words[i];
            for (int j = 1; j <= word.size(); ++j) {
                string t = word.substr(0, j);
                if (s.count(t)) {
                    words[i] = t;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        string ans = "";
        for (string& word : words) ans += word + " ";
        ans.pop_back();
        return ans;
    }
};
